steps.name: Open Settings and verify default model is Free
Expect "toBeVisible" getByTestId('GroupChannelInfoSettings').locator('div.chakra-stack').filter({ has: getByText('Group Pricing Model', { exact: true }) }).last()
Group pricing model should be "Free" getByTestId('GroupChannelInfoSettings').locator('div.chakra-stack').filter({ has: getByText('Group Pricing Model', { exact: true }) }).last()
Click getByRole('button', { name: 'Change Pricing Model', exact: true })
Expect "toBeVisible" getByText('Update Group Pricing', { exact: true })
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('button', { name: 'Select Free pricing', exact: true })
Click getByRole('button', { name: 'Select Monthly Subscription pricing', exact: true })
Wait for selector getByLabel('Set Your Monthly Price')
Update Pricing → confirm dialog → Apply Changes
Click getByRole('button', { name: 'Update Pricing', exact: true })
Confirmation dialog should state "You're changing from Free to Monthly Paid" locator('[data-testid="pricing-confirmation-modal"], [role="dialog"][aria-label="Confirm Pricing Update"]')
Confirmation dialog should show the entered price $10 locator('[data-testid="pricing-confirmation-modal"], [role="dialog"][aria-label="Confirm Pricing Update"]')

Confirmation dialog should show the member's total $13 — the $10 group price plus the $3 platform fee. A dialog showing only $10 means the leader is never told what members really pay. locator('[data-testid="pricing-confirmation-modal"], [role="dialog"][aria-label="Confirm Pricing Update"]')
Click locator('[data-testid="pricing-confirmation-modal"], [role="dialog"][aria-label="Confirm Pricing Update"]').getByRole('button', { name: 'Apply Changes', exact: true })
Verify success toast and persisted Monthly summary
